versions.changelog:
Initial release of Dev Pet skill.

- Introduces a virtual pet companion for developers with 73+ species.
- Real-time pet care features: hunger, health, happiness, discipline, evolution, and permanent death.
- Includes endpoints for registration, adoption, status, care actions, preferences, history, graveyard, and hall of fame.
- Pixel art creatures evolve; supports multiple pet families.
- API and instructions provided for interaction at animalhouse.ai.
